environment.description: Same Actix-web binary deployed in EKS pod. Authentication tokens are RS256 JWTs where the signing key is held exclusively in AWS CloudHSM (cluster ID: hsm-abc123) via PKCS#11 interface. The verification path uses a custom Actix middleware that calls the CloudHSM cluster's verify operation for each request token. The HSM key policy (CU user 'app-signer') has a key attribute template with CKA_SIGN=true but CKA_VERIFY is delegated to a separate CU user 'app-verifier'. The JWT claims include a custom 'writable_fields' array populated at token issuance time by the identity provider (Keycloak with custom protocol mapper). The CloudHSM-backed token cannot be forged to include additional writable_fields because the signing key never leaves the HSM boundary. The Actix middleware extracts 'writable_fields' from the verified token and injects it into request extensions. However, the update_user handler shown does NOT check request extensions - it processes all deserialized fields unconditionally. A secondary OPA sidecar (deployed as Envoy ext_authz filter) evaluates policy rego that intersects the request JSON body keys against the token's writable_fields claim, returning 403 if any non-permitted field is present in the request body. The OPA policy bundle is signed and fetched from S3 with bucket policy restricting PutObject to the CI/CD role only.

config.hsm: AWS CloudHSM cluster hsm-abc123, PKCS#11, firmware 3.4.4
config.token_signing: RSA-2048 key CKA_EXTRACTABLE=false, CKA_SIGN=true on CU 'app-signer'
config.token_verification: Custom middleware calls C_Verify via pkcs11 crate against CloudHSM
config.opa_sidecar: OPA 0.58 as Envoy ext_authz gRPC filter, policy: deny if request_body_keys - token.writable_fields != empty_set
config.opa_policy_integrity: S3 bundle signing, bucket policy restricts writes to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-deploy-role
config.envoy_config: ext_authz filter in DENY mode (fail-closed), positioned before route to upstream
config.network_policy: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts pod ingress to Envoy sidecar port only
